title: Aeronautics-PBR
description: 16x LabPBR Resource Pack for Create Aeronautics
body:
This resource pack adds PBR to almost all textures in [Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics).
It was inspired by [UltimaCraft PBR](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ultimacraft-pbr) and [Create-PBR](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/create-pbr).
I recommend using them together as they visually match well.

Due to certain circumstances, PBR has been applied to the following blocks in addition to the Create Aeronautics blocks:
- Smart Observer
- Block of Industrial Iron
